$comment: The full reference face set (#31): the licensed test clips of test-media/ and the faces of this folder (README.md for their sources and licences). `ouaf preview --references test-media/faces/all.json` renders on all of them; test-media/references.json, the default set, is a short selection. Fields: id (screenshot name), file (relative to this file: a clip rendered frame by frame from `from` to `time`, media time in s, the screenshot being the frame at `time`; or an image, rendered `frames` times, 10 by default), maxFaces (faces the host tracks), faces (faces the reference engine finds at the screenshot, checked by the browser tests: 0 for a negative or a hard case), description.
